title: listen
prompt:
Mobile screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam": a chapter cram sheet with Listen mode playing. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
Header: back link "Study guides", large title "Law of Agency", subtitle "Chapter 2 of 19". A segmented control "Cram sheet" (selected) / "Full notes".
Content: a "Must know" numbered list card where item 4 is currently being read aloud: it is highlighted with a subtle green left border and a soft green tint; the other items are normal.
Bottom: above the floating tab bar, a compact glass now-playing capsule (fully rounded): a route bullet red "2", text "Must know 4 of 35" and secondary "Law of Agency", then controls: previous, a large play/pause circle button (green), next, and a speed chip "1.25x".
